reviews.text: Amazing Pool Plaster did new natural stone coping and all new tile for our pool. They did a great job at a fare price and the pool has never looked this good.
reviews.author: Mike Secor

reviews.text: I recently had my old pool re-plastered by Amazing Pool Plaster, and I was very pleasantly surprised by the great job they did.  Their price was the most competitive compared to other quotes I got, and they did a ton of work preparing and replastering.  Great communications from Gustavo throughout the process and it was very clear that they know what they are doing.  5 Star 🌟 rating from me.  Thank you for doing an AMAZING JOB!!!
reviews.author: Jeff Fene

reviews.text: They did a great job on our pool, we got new coping, tile and plaster.  It turned out amazing, they were prompt and did the work very quickly and coordinated.  The finished product was amazing.  They also were the low bid I received, I would highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Jim Nolden

reviews.text: They did a great job on our pool plaster.  Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: John Bacon

reviews.text: Amazing! Just like the name said, very details oriented and professional. I can nor be happier with my pool renovation and the way Gustavo works and communities with us. Thanks for our amazing pool!
reviews.author: Jorge Ventura

data.summary: The 5 Google reviews appear authentic in content, mentioning specific work, a contact person, and competitive pricing. However, the extremely low volume of reviews (only 5) and the perfect 5.0 score with no negative feedback is unusual for an established contractor and warrants caution. There is no evidence of fake review patterns like same-day posting, but the sample size is too small to be definitive.
fake_signals: Some reviews are very brief and generic (e.g., 'They did a great job')
authentic_signals: Specific project details mentioned (coping, tile, replastering)
Varied writing styles and reviewer names
Mentions of competitive pricing and good communication
Reviews span multiple years (2 years ago to 1 month ago)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Limited data shows consistent high ratings on available platforms (Google, BBB). No contradictory low ratings found.
